name: inoa-games
description: Inoa Games — a browser game hub (Three.js) by Inoa Services. Static site: index.html + games/*.html.

scripts.test:all: for g in drift runner tidelines fit junk brew builders tray trivia draw dominoes golf depths safari bubbles memory pixelpact index; do node test/run.js $g test/$g.js; done
scripts.app:sync: node tools/build_app_www.mjs --site https://inoa-games.vercel.app && cd app && npx cap sync
scripts.test:party: for s in pad hub drift trivia games pact approve relay runner dominoes golf; do node test/party.js test/party_$s.js; done
